_readme: Edit this file to change the text in the room panels on the Architecture page. Each key matches a data-room value in assets/svg/*.svg. 'photo' is optional: put an image path (e.g. assets/image/grains-store.jpg) and an 'photoAlt'. 'tab' optionally links to a drawing tab (elevation, section, first-floor, second-floor); 'focus' is the room to highlight there. All description text below is placeholder copy.

grains-store.name: Grains Store
grains-store.description: Placeholder text. A short description of how the grains store was used by the household will go here.

household-store.name: Store for Household Items
household-store.description: Placeholder text. A short description of the household store and the objects once kept here will go here.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Placeholder text. A short description of the kitchen and its hearth will go here.

living-room.name: Living Room
living-room.description: Placeholder text. A short description of the living room and daily family life will go here.

altar-room.name: Altar Room
altar-room.description: Placeholder text. A short description of the altar room and the household's religious practice will go here.

level-kitchen.name: Kitchen level
level-kitchen.description: Placeholder text. The uppermost living level of the house, shown in section.

level-store-room.name: Store room level
level-store-room.description: Placeholder text. The middle level of the house, used for storage, shown in section.

level-house-stable.name: House stable level
level-house-stable.description: Placeholder text. The ground level of the house, where animals were kept, shown in section.
